description: Count messages in a folder matching optional search criteria. Returns just a number (no envelopes fetched). The attachment filters (`hasAttachment`, `attachmentName`, `attachmentType`) are rejected here — they require an envelope scan that defeats the count's speed promise. Use search_messages for attachment-based filtering. A non-selectable namespace container (e.g. `Folders`/`Labels`) is rejected with an actionable error rather than returning 0.

folder.description: Folder to count in (default: INBOX). A non-selectable namespace container like `Folders`/`Labels` is rejected.

match.description: Optional search criteria to narrow the count (same fields as search_messages: from, to, subject, body, since, before, seen, flagged, larger, smaller, listId). Attachment filters are NOT allowed here — use search_messages for those. Omit to count every message in the folder.

attachmentName.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on attachment filenames (e.g. "invoice", ".pdf"). Implies hasAttachment.

attachmentType.description: Case-insensitive MIME-type prefix filter on attachments (e.g. "application/pdf", "image/"). Implies hasAttachment.

name: count_messages
